test_title: PYST 18: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 7 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 56 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling time = 7

Emptying time = 56

Work required = 1 ÷ 4

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Net efficiency = Filling rate − Emptying rate

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 7 and 56 = 56

⇒ Total work = 56 units

⇒ Efficiency of filling pipe = 56 ÷ 7 = 8 units/min

⇒ Efficiency of emptying pipe = 56 ÷ 56 = 1 unit/min

⇒ Net efficiency = 8 − 1 = 7 units/min

⇒ Work for 1 ÷ 4 tank = 56 ÷ 4 = 14 units

⇒ Time = 14 ÷ 7

⇒ Time = 2 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 2 minutes.**
